text:
taylor: heads up - noticed a bunch of spikes in billing for project-bounded keys that were routed through our proxy. appears tokens counted twice: once under project and once under org default. repro in prod about ~2026-03-19 14:10 UTC. anyone seen duplicate meter increments?

rachel: ugh. did the proxy add another billing tag? we added `billing.bucket` in the proxy recently for multi-tenant visibility.

samir: quick check: router ingestion pipeline expects a single `billing.project` tag. if proxy emits `billing.bucket=org:project` and router also emits `billing.project=project`, aggregation might double-count depending on downstream join.

laura: is this only for project-scoped keys or also org keys with X-Project? I can check graphs.

rachel: initial scatter shows most affected are keys minted with scope=project but used via proxy that also rewrites headers for routing.

samir: probable root cause: metric emission happens in two places - auth service (post-introspection) and proxy enrichment (pre-router), both increment `billing.tokens` with slightly different labels. we relied on deterministic dedupe by request_id, but proxy didn't forward request_id for some requests.

devops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-0319-02 - duplicate-billing-proxies; severity P2.

laura: short-term mitigation: make proxy stop emitting billing metrics and let a single canonical place (router) own billing. low risk rollback.

rachel: agree, revert proxy metric emission by feature flag. we should also add a schema guard so duplicate metrics with same request_id are ignored.

samir: long-term: unify attribution flow to a single source of truth. proposal: auth -> router -> meter. auth populates `resolved_project` + `attribution_source` but does not increment billing. router computes final bucket and emits metrics once. proxy can enrich but must not emit billing.

laura: console UX ask: customers saw a one-off spike in project dashboard and raised tickets. we need a way to show 'attribution confidence' in UI (high/low) and a small banner when anomalies are suspected.

rachel: telemetry change: add tags `attribution.confidence:{high,low}` and `attribution.path:{auth_only,proxy_enriched,router}`. keep tags as strings to avoid TSDB schema churn.

samir: can we also add a deterministic request fingerprint header (`X-RW-Req`) generated at edge and propagated everywhere? would make dedupe easy.

taylor: edge-gen `X-RW-Req` sounds good. ensure it's signed? not necessary for dedupe but helpful for tracing. do it at edge LB.

laura: migration/backfill question: customers want corrected billing for the last 7 days. accounting/legal says retroactive credits need careful review. ops: how expensive is reprocessing raw events to collapse duplicates?

rachel: backfill plan: reprocess events for affected orgs only and produce corrected aggregates into a separate namespace `billing-corrected`. then we can run diff and send credit proposals. avoids touching main metric timeline until approval.

accounting-bot: Note: any retroactive credits require finance approval; include org list and delta estimate in the PR.

samir: rollout plan for the fix: 1) disable proxy metric emission (0-1 day) 2) deploy edge `X-RW-Req` (canary 10%) 3) router dedupe using request header (canary 10% -> 100% over 3 days) 4) add attribution tags and console confidence panels.

rachel: QA items: unit tests for dedupe, e2e with proxy enabled/disabled, load test to validate no metric gap, smoke dashboards to compare pre/post canary.

taylor: console alerting: add rule: if project tokens change >20% and `attribution.confidence=low` fire incident to eng-platform and product.

laura: we should ship a small customer-facing note: "We detected duplicate billing metrics for a subset of requests; investigating" so support isn't surprised. coordinate with comms.

samir: patch sketch in router config: 
```yaml
billing:
  canonical_emitter: router
  dedupe_by_header: X-RW-Req
  attribution_tags: [resolved_project, attribution.path, attribution.confidence]
```

rachel: +1. I'll open the proxy rollback PR. taylor, assign me for the canary gating.

devops-bot: Deployment: feature-flag `proxy-billing-emitter` disabled in prod for service `proxy-tenant` - job #987 completed.

taylor: thanks all. I'll follow up with customer success and finance on credit next steps. keep posting updates here.
